reviews.t: Love the product - not crazy for the scents
reviews.x: This product is incredible. It stops armpit oder- I’m talking 101 Texas heat, three mile walk, oder. It’s quite incredible. The cream is a little messy, so I really like that they now have the solid stick. I do not love the scent of any of the scents they have, so there is something in it that has a bit of an off-putting smell when first applied. However, for as good as it works, I swear by and recommend it. It’s revolutionary. I get the unscented (still a little of that scent I’m not crazy abou

We've tried many of the "safer" deodorants, including the Native brand.  My poor daughter's body odor was just too much for Native to handle; she still smelled like an onion.  This Lume brand of deodorant is pretty phenomenal stuff!!  ***The key for Lume to be effective is to apply right after washing; that provides Lume a "clean slate" where its formula may keep bacteria away.***  We monitored how Lume did on my daughter for about a week; she typically showers at night before bed.  After doing

I saw a review about a child who had a medical condition that caused her to have a bad odor, and this deodorant actually helped. So I figured I’d try it. I didn’t want to use antiperspirant but nothing works all day. I ordered the coconut scent and Unscented for one of my kids. It worked for me. It’s not perfect every day, but most days it works! I will continue to order even though the price is a little high for the amount you get. But sometimes there is a sale or special price on a bundle pack

[[VIDEOID:391d0888f396cc871e8fb3d7975aeb46]] I ordered this after I saw several commercials. I didn't expect much but wanted to give it a try. First let me say that I am mostly bed bound and a shower is hard for me and a luxury. So I need all the help I can get in Staying fresh and clean. I got the three pack of the solid sticks thinking of better control and less spilling in my bags. The unscented is the one I was interested in first and the sage and peony next. I got pineapple and  a sage with

I originally tried the Lume in the tube and it worked ok (6-8 hours max) and smelled pretty bad when applying (especially considering I had to use my hand 😬). After seeing that it would work well enough, I decided to try to sticks.  Game changer!! The scent is better, lasts longer and is a breeze to apply.

I was excited to hear how well this  Deodorant work but unfortunately for me It did not. After having it on for about an hour you can start smelling the scent that you are wearing even the unscented. I would not recommend this for someone who may have overactive glands or have a problem with under order on any  level.  Lume is just an overprice override deodorant.. This stuff  REALLY works for sweaty areas that I’m too embarrassed to name, I’m sure those that have the same issue will know where I’m talking about!  I’m not to excited about the scent, but it’s not horrible my any means.  No issues with irritation or reactions to the ingredients.  I do feel it’s quite expensive but a little goes a long way and I don’t need to re-apply it during the day so I think it’s worth the cost to stay smelling nice and fresh.

reviews.t: It doesn’t work you smell like BO all day!
reviews.x: I purchased these, because I love the idea of them being all natural. I bought the trio pack and they are Hella expensive. These do not work the coconut smelling one smells like almost like BO itself. Don’t waste your moneys I have three of these now I’ve tried all three flavors hoping that one of them work they do not and I smelled like underlying BO all day. They are sticky as well. Made my pits feel way sticky or anywhere else it was applied.

I never had a deodorant that kept me from smelling and kept me dry. It's like either or. But so far this has done the best job of keeping me from smelling. I'm actually impressed. I still get sweaty though. The smell of the deodorant is okay and could be better but it's not awful Iike some folks claim. Wish it was cheaper to buy though.

reviews.t: Not sure how I feel about it- *EDIT* I returned this!
reviews.x: Only on day 2 and may update soon, but I'm not entirely impressed. It does not keep me from sweating though I think it keeps me from smelling. You could not go 72 whole hours without reapplying if you do any kind of physical activity. Even if you're just sitting doing nothing you couldn't go 72 hours. Idk, I'm trying not to use so many chemicals but this is making me think aluminum is one I can't do without. It is NOT worth the price! I only bought the sampler because a single was 15$  Edit- I g

A product that works as advertised. The scents could be better but that isn't a big issue because I use can use perfume or body spray if I want to. I will be purchasing again. Update: I just opened my Lume deodorant 3 pack and was very happy with the scent of the Coconut Crush. It smells nice. The Lavender Sage is ok but a bit stronger of a scent and I prefer food scents more. Also, these are like the stick deodorant you see from other brands. The older one I just finished has 3 slits in the top

reviews.t: Great stuff. Really does what it says
reviews.x: I’ve used the lotion deodorant and ordered the stick to be less messy. Will see if this is as good. Best ,most effective deodorant I’ve ever used. Not a great smell out of container but adjusts as it’s on your body. It’s spendy but it truly amazing . I do love the warm vanilla out of all the fragrances I’m hoping the solid stick is a bit longer lasting . If it is it will be a better deal .

These have a great texture and work very well. However, the scent combinations are a little weird. Like almost good, but the combinations make it weird. Lavender, good! Combined with sage? A little too earthy and man-ish. Coconut, good! Combined with something else… strange. Unscented is great, except I like to have scent.
Only an apocalypse will keep me from buying this stuff. Not only do I not stink-i remain odor free for like 24 hours. It does not irritate my skin whatsoever. This is good stuff!

reviews.t: Awesome product (best used on places without hair)
reviews.x: Lume is amazing! I have horrible smells behind my ears and nothing could touch it. Lume made the smell go away for the first time in years. I will say, try all the scents, make sure to find products from trusted sellers or youll be ripped off like the jasmine and rose lume that is selling a stick for outrages prices

The solid stick is not the same as the cream version. Solid stick does not last me 7 hours where as the cream stick lasts me two days. I checked the ingredients and they’re completely different. Go with the cream version.
I was a Native deodorant user and never had a smell but thought I'd try this. Not worth the money. I smelled terrible, sweat more than normal and was a weird texture.
Purchased the Lume 3 pack Tangerine in solid stick. Very impressed because I participate in adult sports and this the product keeps me dry and smells great.
The solid or cream the product works . The only problem with the solid is it can transfer onto dark clothes or anything rubbed against.
The smell of the deodorant is a bit different than traditional deodorants, however, it works great against odor.
Dislike the unscented. Smells old, mildewy. I do not like the unscented it stinks

reviews.t: Dont get the solid get the cream version
reviews.x: The solid is too sticky, pulls skin while applying, gave me a rash.
Skin irritation to lavender.  Citrus & scent free work great.
My wife loves the different scents available

I like this solid stick version much better than the lotion deodorant with the 3 lotion slots. It's also much easier & gentler to glide on than Native deodorant is. That said, the scents & product in general don't really work that great. It'll keep you from smelling for about 4 to 6 hours, in my experience. claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the product effectively controls body odor, including in difficult situations.
Many reviewers dislike or are unimpressed by the scents, finding them weird or unpleasant.
Some reviewers say the product did not work for them or did not control odor as expected.
Reviewers appreciate the stick format as less messy and better than the cream/tube version.
Several reviewers note the product does not stop sweating, only odor.
